USB31_byte_finding.location: MCU software TX ring, behind an already published packet
USB31_byte_finding.scope: Initial63-byte diagnostic Alive, not product Heartbeat or PARAM_VALUE
USB31_byte_finding.different_from_previous_fix_signature: This is not an idle/writable FIFO with a software tail and missing rearm. The published packet still lacks its local pickup/completion witness.
USB31_byte_finding.subsequent_progress: Same epoch1 later records publish104/pickup103 and46 successful flush commits. Later diagnostic/private frames are CRC complete; bounded same-epoch flush-only recovery made progress without replaying the frame.
USB31_byte_finding.terminal_later_pending_record: Generation104 ring31 is a different transaction. Its strict relationship to PC reader shutdown remains unproven; do not merge it with initial generation3.
USB31_byte_finding.unresolved_boundary: For the initial publication, no generation-bound timestamped proof distinguishes missing host IN service from an MCU completion-event observation failure. Sticky IN-token/Connected bits alone do not prove a pending Windows Read.

READY_ARM_semantics.meaning: USB-only diagnostic session/readiness binding, not flight arming and not radio-health certification
READY_ARM_semantics.why_they_can_succeed_after_AUX_fault: The failure diagnostic loop intentionally continues private clock/READY/ARM handling. The readiness gate checks boot/epoch/session/nonce and USB publication, not E220/runtime health.
READY_ARM_semantics.pre_ARM_radio_activity: Normal TDD/RF processing continues while initial Ground product USB admission waits for HostArm.
READY_ARM_semantics.first32_byte_identity: TDD DoneDrain status and the only accepted32-byte Ground write are consistent with a normal UL_IDLE response. Exact writer/action/payload is not stored, so this identity remains an inference.

offline_replay.implementation: Exact frozen candidate E220WriteContract; no implementation change
offline_replay.what_is_proven: Given the saved boundary times, the2-second failure and permanent latch reproduce. The normal0.53-second observation completes after the existing stable-HIGH/service-floor requirements.
offline_replay.what_is_not_proven: Electrical/RF initiating cause, exact live polling schedule, complete product test or full regression acceptance

remaining_minimal_discriminants_not_impl: Preserve the first Ground UART writer owner, action type, token, exact32-byte payload, and matching incoming Grant/control identity on the same MCU clock.

Capture the first-fault-local AUX edges/polls with interrupt coverage/latency evidence; correlate with module RX/TX and M0/M1 actual state. Physical AUX capture is needed to distinguish missed transitions from a genuinely long LOW waveform.

For USB, bind IN-token/IN_EMPTY/pickup observations to the failing publish generation and lifecycle. Independently correlate host USB IN service before/after publication; COM Read call history alone is not a bus-level proof.

Keep USB-ready, radio-healthy and product-Heartbeat-ready verdicts distinct. Do not lengthen106ms/2seconds, auto-clear the safety latch, or force-replay accepted bytes without evidence and separate implementation authorization.

manufacturer_background_only.summary: The manufacturer describes AUX as a combined send/receive-buffer and self-check indicator; LOW alone does not identify one internal activity or prove hardware failure.
manufacturer_background_only.applicability_limit: E220-900T22D reference manual only. The physical variant is not established by this investigation; this document is not used to attribute the5-second interval to a particular mode or hardware defect.

conclusion_ja: 直接の停止経路はAUXの2秒制限による永続停止で特定できた。通信できた比較回ではAUX LOW→HIGH観測が約0.53秒、停止2回では約5.05秒。なぜ約5秒の間隔になったかは未確定。診断USBの初回31byteはソフトウェア待ちで、後続送信は進行しており40秒間永久滞留の証明ではない。USB失敗をAUX停止の単一共通原因とする説明は記録と合わない。
